description: This file defines an abstract class 'SimpleHashingStrategyBase' that implements the 'HashingStrategy' interface. It provides a concrete implementation of 'calculateHashFromDescription' method that computes a hash value based on a description object, and declares an abstract method for subclasses to implement specific hashing logic.

classes.name: SimpleHashingStrategyBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for hashing strategies based on descriptions, allowing subclasses to define specific hashing logic.

methods.name: calculateHashFromDescription
methods.description: Calculates a hash value from a Description object and the total number of groups, using the subclass-defined hashing logic.

methods.name: calculateHashFromDescription
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to compute a hash value from a Description object.
